notes: PAPER REFERENCE DATA — NOT EXPERIMENTAL OUTPUT. Values taken from Kutlu & Emiroglu (MDPI Computers 2025, 14, 511), which reports YOLOv8n results. These numbers are NOT expected to match our YOLOv12n experimental results. File provided as a placeholder because our YOLOv12n Round 5 was skipped (no verified samples carried over from Round 4). Do not use these values as experimental output for YOLOv12n.

metric_notes.aggregate_precision: Paper reports 1.00 at peak F1 confidence (0.301) for all-classes. Mean of per-class precisions would be 0.925; the values diverge because the paper's aggregate metric is evaluated at a different confidence threshold than the per-class peak-F1 thresholds.
metric_notes.recall_derivation: Recall values are derived analytically from reported F1 and Precision via R = F1*P / (2P - F1); the paper does not report recall directly.
metric_notes.mAP50-95: Not reported in the source paper.
